messages:
Ally (People Ops): Morning team! Kicking off a quick logistics thread for 'Gratitude Bins Week' — idea: put small drop boxes in offices (SF, NY, LON) during Apr 20-24 where people can drop handwritten/printed thank-you notes. People Ops will collect and pick top ~20 notes to turn into spot awards (small gift card + shoutout). Need owners for bins, remote kit, comms, and budget signoff. :tada:

Jesse (Eng): Love this. I can own SF bins and pickup schedule. Which locations in SF?

Morgan (Facilities): I’ll handle NY and coordinate with LON facilities partner for a delivery. For SF I recommend kitchen + 3rd-floor lounge. Any size constraints?

Ally (People Ops): Great. Thanks both. Bins can be shoebox-sized — lockable tops preferred. Evan, can facilities provide lockable tubs or do we buy?

Evan (Office Ops): We have some spare lockable tubs in storage — can label them. I'll confirm dimensions by EOD. Also can arrange a secure pickup on Apr 26.

Priya (People Ops): I’ll draft the comms and a printable note template. Putting together a brief thread + poster. For remote folks we should send a 'gratitude kit' (pre-stamped postcard + return envelope) and provide a prepaid drop option.

Sam (Finance): Budget quick check: if we plan 20 spot awards at $50 each + $150 for bins and $200 shipping/international, that's $1,450. Is that the cap? Need to route through team events budget or recognition budget?

Ally (People Ops): Recognition budget preferred. Can we confirm $1,500 as cushion, Sam?

Sam (Finance): That’s fine pending a short expense request form. Please include expected headcount of participants for reporting.

Priya (People Ops): Draft comms here (first pass):
```
Subject: Gratitude Bins Week (Apr 20–24)
Hey team — next month we’re trying something new: Gratitude Bins Week. Drop a note in your office bin or mail a postcard from home. We’ll pick favorites to receive a small spot award + shoutout. Make someone’s week!
What to do: 1) Drop a note in the bin 2) For remote, mail your postcard to People Ops (prepaid kits will be sent) 3) Nominate a note for a spot award via /nominate with a short reason
Click here to sign up to help steward a bin: <https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/fake-signup-sheet>|
```

Jesse (Eng): Sign-up link works for me. I'll add times for weekly pickups.

awards-bot: Heads-up — use /nominate to record award conversions so Finance tracks spend. See /help awards for format. :robot_face:

Priya (People Ops): Quick checklist (please reply with ✅ if you can own):
``
- Bin owners: SF (Jesse) ✅, NY (Morgan) ?, LON (Facilities partner) ?
- Remote kits: People Ops (Priya) ?
- Comms + posters: Priya (People Ops) ✅
- Budget signoff & expense form: Sam (Finance) ?
- Pickup & secure storage: Evan (Office Ops) ?
- Award selection panel: Ally + Priya + 2 volunteers ?
```

Morgan (Facilities): NY owner ✅. I’ll confirm LON contact and put on the pickup calendar.

Evan (Office Ops): Pickup & storage ✅. I'll add a 30-min pickup window in the calendar invite.

Sam (Finance): Budget signoff ✅ — will approve the expense request once submitted. Please tag cost center RD-OPS.

Ally (People Ops): Perfect. Two quick asks: 1) Priya please send the comms draft by next Tue so we can preview during All-Hands. 2) Everyone who volunteered, add availability in the sign-up sheet.

Priya (People Ops): Will do — aiming to send to the All-Hands dropbox by Mon EOD. Also prepping a short HQ poster PDF and an email version for remote piers.

Jesse (Eng): Thx team — happy to help with SF pickup. PS: can we get small stickers for the bins that say 'Gratitude Bins Week'? happy to print.

Ally (People Ops): Love the sticker idea, Jesse. Go for it — please run mockup by me before printing. :slightly_smiling_face:

Morgan (Facilities): One note — some buildings require courier paperwork for receiving postcards. I'll flag that and DM Priya any forms.

Priya (People Ops): Noted, thanks Morgan. I'll compile any forms in the Google sheet under 'logistics' tab.

Ally (People Ops): Thanks all — will check back after comms draft. If anyone else wants to join the selection panel or help with remote fulfilment, please reply here. :heart:

Sam (Finance): Quick reminder: capture receipts and tag RD-OPS in expense entries.

awards-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-04-15 09:00 — 'Finalize Gratitude Bins Week comms & kits'

Ally (People Ops): Closing loop: next update Tue 09:00 PT. Appreciate the quick volunteers. :tada:
